model.roofHeight.original: 93.5 in turret height; excludes viewer/weapon overall height

model.hullLength.original: 312 in M1A1 side-view hull drawing; inherited chassis envelope

model.turretLength,model.turretWidth.note: Top-view silhouette only, not a measured armour layout

model.turretOrigin,model.turretPivot,mod.note: Art origin +0.15m, ring pivot [+0.66m,0], muzzle tip in art coordinates [5.717m,0]; shared Canvas/SVG/event frame. No real weapon calibration.

massKg.original: 69.54 US short tons (manufacturer labels curb weight)

mobility.reverseSpeed.original: 25 mph paved level surface; family and SEP manual reference

mobility.accelerationReferenceSpeed,mobi.original: 0–20 mph in 7.2 s; simplified integrator calibrated to this endpoint

mobility.gradeSpeedPoints.original: 10% grade 17 mph, 60% grade 4.1 mph; downhill symmetry is tuning

mobility.maxLongitudinalGrade,mobility.m.original: 60% longitudinal, 40% side grade; combined inclines handled conservatively

mobility.powertrain.note: Forward 5.877/3.021/1.891/1.278 and reverse 8.305/2.354 adopted reference ratios. Shift schedule, 1.645m/s² launch limit, force exponent, losses, 0.18s direction settle, 0.42s shift, 1.20s dwell, steering and arrival thresholds are TACTICAL game approximations. Mass and 1500hp come from this profile; calibration is limited to the published 0–20mph in 7.2s endpoint.

sensors.eyeHeight.note: User-selected CITV-level viewpoint above ground; NOT turret-roof height and NOT an exact published optical-axis measurement

sensors.ambient,sensors.commander,sensor.note: WIP07A channel provenance, forward reciprocal scans and independent evidence decay; 200m silhouette-only, commander 2500m 90deg 50deg/s, gunner 2000m 30deg 40deg/s. Equipment flags independent of hunter-killer. See docs/OBSERVATION_WIP07A.md for evidence, memory and designation defaults.

sensors.observationLimit.note: Observation computation cap; not an actual guaranteed detection or identification distance

weapons.mainGun.referenceEngagementRange.note: Future engagement reference only; not a ballistic maximum and does not limit LOS

artId.note: Vehicle registry IDs and artwork IDs are independent; this stage supports M1A2 artwork only

fireControl.note: WIP10 retains the fictional RTS dispersion/lay/range/lead/stabilization budget, removes the duplicate statistical manoeuvre term, predicts from observed velocity, and delays the single roll by range divided by the fictional average velocity. Values are not measured M1A2 fire-control or ammunition data. See docs/FIRE_CONTROL_WIP10.md.

fireControl.impact.note: 64 rejection samples, 2m terrain/building march and 3000m beyond-target cap generate a post-result visual point. The point never determines hit, penetration or damage.

weapons.mainGun.ammunitionCapacity.note: Test-round counter and abstract manual firing active; no ammo split, loading transport, ballistic/penetration/damage model

exposure.note: Hull/turret sample locations follow model heights; not a hit probability model

navigation.note: Cannon tube does not collide; 16m navigation nodes and conservative circle are retained

combat.note: 1450 abstract HP and KE/CE zone values; WIP11A uses KE only and no module/crew damage

weapons.mainGun.ricochet.note: M829A2 game chance: 78° 0%, 80° 50%, 81° 100%; roll<chance. Independent of hit and hit-zone rolls.

weapons.mainGun.highAnglePenetration.note: Existing 60° value interpolates linearly to zero at 90°. Values beyond 90° clamp only for defensive input handling.

limits: The WIP13 drivetrain is a deterministic lightweight game approximation, not a full engine, converter, hydraulic, track-contact or suspension simulation
Observation channels use fictional RTS timing and seeded thresholds, terrain/building/forest geometry; no weather, night or real thermal-sensor performance model
No SEP armour values or specific ammunition performance are inferred; firing uses fictional game probabilities
WIP12 penetration, damage and ricochet are abstract game tables; ricochet continuation is display-only and has no further collision or damage; no module, crew, fire or ammunition-rack model
